URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/5/14/iran-urges-brics-nations-to-condemn-us-israeli-war-aggression

BRICS+ foreign ministers meeting in New Delhi 14-15 May 2026.

Araghchi direct quotes:
- "victim of illegal expansionism and warmongering"
- UAE "directly involved in the aggression against my country"
- Called for BRICS to "explicitly condemn violations of international law by the United States and Israel"

India's position:
- Foreign Minister Subrahmanyam Jaishankar acknowledged the meeting "at a time of considerable flux in international relations"
- India's External Affairs Ministry condemned the attack on an Indian-flagged vessel off Oman as "unacceptable"
- Expressed concern about targeting commercial shipping

UAE response:
- No documented direct pushback in this article
- "It was not immediately clear how or whether the UAE and other nations attending the BRICS+ meeting had responded to Araghchi's remarks"

Final communique:
- No joint statement confirmed
- Iran's Deputy Minister Kazem Gharibabadi noted "one member country" pushed for language condemning Iran, preventing consensus
- Gharibabadi warned against appearing divided

Figures:
- India sources ~50% crude via Strait of Hormuz
- 20% of world's oil passes through the waterway in peacetime

BRICS+ members present: Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa, Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran, and UAE.
